Alger, 13 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 13, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — A recent study conducted in the United Kingdom highlights recruitment intentions in the tech sector, emphasizing the importance of artificial intelligence skills and human oversight. These data provide a useful benchmark for professionals assessing international client requirements.
